notes.title: Bulletkour Version 0.4 Released!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

Bulletkour Version 0.4 has been released! We are happy to announce the following features:

[list]
[*] 2 New levels of tutorial - One for shooting and one for wallrunning
[*] General bug fixes
[/list]

Enjoy playing!

notes.title: Bulletkour Early Access Released On Steam!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

Bulletkour has finally released! 2 years in the making and we are proud to say that today is the day. Go grab it for yourself or a friend, it's 10% off!

Have fun playing!
